Stage5_Action: Address both high-demand supply deficits. Use the Stage 2D constraint pattern to determine whether the response should be terrain/infrastructure-led, diagnostic/non-terrain, or mixed.
Stage5_Action_IDN: Tangani kekurangan ketersediaan pada kedua kanal. Gunakan diagnosis Stage 2D untuk menentukan apakah respons perlu berfokus pada infrastruktur, diagnosis non-terrain, atau kombinasi keduanya.

Stage5_Action: Prioritize BTS/backhaul/signal improvement, operator coordination, infrastructure sharing, and maintenance access.
Stage5_Action_IDN: Prioritaskan verifikasi dan penguatan konektivitas digital, termasuk BTS, backhaul, kualitas sinyal, koordinasi operator, berbagi infrastruktur, dan akses pemeliharaan.

Stage5_Action: Diagnose non-terrain constraints before capital investment. Potential explanations include provider/agent coverage, service design, financial literacy, cooperative capacity, affordability, or other residual factors; Stage 2D itself does not identify which.
Stage5_Action_IDN: Lakukan diagnosis lanjutan sebelum investasi modal. Kategori residual tidak mengidentifikasi penyebab spesifik, sehingga cakupan penyedia, desain layanan, pemanfaatan, keterjangkauan, kapasitas kelembagaan, dan faktor lain perlu diverifikasi.

Stage5_Action: Prioritize broader economic-base, accessibility, and livelihood development; monitor financial and digital supply rather than treating current low supply as an immediate high-demand gap.
Stage5_Action_IDN: Prioritaskan penguatan basis ekonomi, aksesibilitas, dan mata pencaharian jangka panjang; pantau perkembangan permintaan serta ketersediaan layanan.

Stage5_Action: No immediate high-demand supply expansion is indicated. Maintain service quality where access is adequate and monitor low-demand/high-supply villages for changing demand conditions.
Stage5_Action_IDN: Tidak terdapat kebutuhan ekspansi pasokan berpermintaan tinggi yang segera berdasarkan indikator penelitian. Pertahankan kualitas layanan dan monitor perubahan permintaan serta ketersediaan.
